new_source_qualifications.text: Dodos–Kanellopoulos is a verified published work. The exact Theorem 5.1 was inspected in arXiv:1610.00487v4, after publication; the final typeset statement was not compared. The appendix repairs the majorant norm exponent in the imported Frei–Tinková proof route. That local repair does not independently close all of the preprint’s new analytic proof steps.

Only the one-parameter published GT results and specified rational/metric claim are used. Gaussian ideal convolution, coefficient extrapolation, norm transfer and general-weight recombination are newly proved steps, not quotations of an external theorem. No unrestricted general-number-field result is claimed.

The reviewed fragments used GTMobius2012; integrated citation key moebius denotes the same published paper. Its Section 3 is provenance and its p.547 Claim is a scoped theorem input. The paper’s Möbius orthogonality theorem is not invoked for the new von Mangoldt estimates.
